why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 has to FAIL because it can only be checked after merge, and the output has to point at pages.yml or the publish-on-push. The output gives line 3 "FAIL" and says "This line can only be checked after merge." It cites ".github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ to GitHub Pages only on push to main" and quotes the README's "published from `docs/` on every push to main". It also explains that during review the live page still shows the old docs, and it suggests a checkable replacement: docs/index.md documents --shout. The wrong_build section repeats the point. The one required item is handled in full.
